title: Find candidate edges
summary: An edge is a strong image change, often in brightness. Canny finds candidate edges after several processing steps; an edge is not an object label.
introduction: An edge is a strong image change, often in brightness. Canny finds candidate edges after several processing steps; an edge is not an object label. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An edge is a strong image change, often in brightness. Canny finds candidate edges after several processing steps; an edge is not an object label.

blocks.code:
import cv2
import numpy as np

image = np.zeros((20, 20), dtype=np.uint8)
image[5:15, 5:15] = 255
edges = cv2.Canny(image, 50, 150)
print(edges.shape, bool(np.any(edges)))
blocks.title: Find candidate edges

blocks.text: The output is (20, 20) True. The result keeps the image size and contains nonzero edge pixels around the bright square. It does not name the shape for us.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Edge detection does not understand what an object is or whether it is safe.
